description: This file defines the OpportunitiesByLeadSourceByOutcomeDashlet class, a custom dashboard widget for visualizing opportunities data by lead source and outcome within SuiteCRM. It extends DashletGenericChart and includes methods for configuring display options and rendering a stacked bar chart using RGraph based on opportunities data.

classes.name: OpportunitiesByLeadSourceByOutcomeDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard widget class for displaying opportunities categorized by lead source and sales stage as a chart.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Configures and returns display options for the dashlet, particularly lead sources and IDs filters.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML and JavaScript code to render the chart visualization based on opportunities data.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Constructs the SQL query used to retrieve opportunities data grouped by lead source and sales stage.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares and formats the raw data into chart-compatible labels, datasets, tooltips, and keys.
